body:
I'll start by examining the existing `llms.txt` file and setting up the workspace.

Now let me extract all `.md` URLs and build the deduplicated fetch list.

All 55 URLs (the 33 additional were already in `llms.txt`). Now fetching all with `curl -fsSL`, recording any failures.

All 55 files captured, zero 404s. Now determining the pinned uv version.

Docs consistently reference uv `0.13.9` and GitHub confirms latest release `0.13.9` (2026-11-17) — they match. Now gathering line-cited facts for the manifest.

All facts gathered. Now computing byte/line stats for the manifest table.

All data gathered. Writing the manifest now.

Let me verify the citations resolve and files are byte-identical to source.

Capture complete and verified. Final report follows.

## uv capture — done

**Location:** `/tmp/python-research/uv/` — 55 files (all 55 unique `.md` URLs from `llms.txt`, covering the 34 additional required pages, which were already listed), plus `MANIFEST.md`. Zero 404s/MISSING. Spot-checked 3 files with `cmp` against live URLs — byte-identical. All 58 KEY_FACTS citations line-range-checked and content spot-checked; they span 21 distinct files. The ai-guides repo was not touched.

**Pinned uv version: 0.13.9** — docs and current release agree. Evidence: `getting-started__installation.md:26` (`astral.sh/uv/0.13.9/install.sh`), `concepts__build-backend.md:25` (`uv_build>=0.13.9,<0.14`), `guides__integration__docker.md:116`, `guides__integration__github.md:45`, `guides__integration__pre-commit.md:15`. GitHub API `/repos/astral-sh/uv/releases/latest`: tag `0.13.9`, published `2026-11-17T09:57:55Z`.

### 12 most important verified facts

1. `concepts__projects__sync.md:7` — `uv run` automatically locks and syncs the project before invoking a command.
2. `concepts__projects__sync.md:15` — `--locked` errors if the lockfile is out of date; `concepts__projects__sync.md:20` — `--frozen` uses it without checking.
3. `reference__cli.md:1136` — `--offline` disables network access (`UV_OFFLINE`).
4. `concepts__resolution.md:65` — `uv.lock` is a universal resolution, portable across OS/architecture/Python version.
5. `concepts__resolution.md:728` — uv rejects lockfiles with a greater schema version; `:732` — schema bumps only in minor releases.
6. `guides__scripts.md:125` — PEP 723 inline metadata declares script dependencies; `:261` — scripts can be explicitly locked via `uv lock --script`.
7. `concepts__projects__dependencies.md:37` — `--dev`/`--group`/`--optional` route `uv add` to dependency groups and extras.
8. `concepts__projects__workspaces.md:7` — workspaces share one lockfile; `:68` — `workspace = true` resolves members locally instead of from PyPI.
9. `guides__tools.md:12` — `uvx` (= `uv tool run`) runs tools without installing; `concepts__tools.md:23` — environments are disposable cache entries.
10. `concepts__python-versions.md:43` — uv auto-downloads missing Python versions; `:59` — bundles CPython/PyPy distributions; `:178` — respects `requires-python`.
11. `reference__settings.md:1392` — `link-mode` defaults: `clone` (copy-on-write) on macOS/Linux, `hardlink` on Windows; `concepts__cache.md:135` — `uv cache prune --ci` retains source-built wheels.
12. `guides__package.md:108` — trusted publishing needs no credentials; `:144` — `uv publish` uploads PEP 740 attestations. Bonus: `guides__integration__github.md:193` — CI uses `uv sync --locked --all-extras --dev`; `concepts__configuration-files.md:49` — precedence CLI > env vars > config.

`MANIFEST.md` contains the full 55-row `file | exact URL | bytes | lines | why critical` table, the version section with API evidence, 58 numbered KEY_FACTS, and an explicit MISSING: none section.
